Skeleton

Skeleton loaders are placeholder shapes that shimmer while real content loads, reducing perceived latency.

Text Skeleton

Line-height skeletons mimic paragraphs of text.

HTML
<div class="zak-stack" style="max-width:22rem;">
    <span class="zak-skeleton zak-skeleton-lg"></span>
    <span class="zak-skeleton"></span>
    <span class="zak-skeleton zak-skeleton-sm" style="width:70%;"></span>
    <span class="zak-skeleton zak-skeleton-sm" style="width:40%;"></span>
</div>

Circle Skeleton (Avatar)

Use .zak-skeleton-circle for avatar placeholders.

HTML
<div style="display:flex;gap:0.75rem;align-items:center;">
    <span class="zak-skeleton zak-skeleton-circle"></span>
    <div class="zak-stack" style="width:10rem;">
        <span class="zak-skeleton zak-skeleton-sm"></span>
        <span class="zak-skeleton zak-skeleton-sm" style="width:60%;"></span>
    </div>
</div>

Rectangle Skeleton (Image)

Set explicit dimensions to reserve space for images or media.

HTML
<span class="zak-skeleton" style="width:16rem;height:9rem;border-radius:var(--zak-radius-lg);"></span>

Skeleton Card

A full card layout preview with image, title, and body lines.

HTML
<div class="zak-card" style="max-width:20rem;padding:1rem;">
    <span class="zak-skeleton" style="width:100%;height:8rem;"></span>
    <div class="zak-stack" style="margin-top:1rem;">
        <span class="zak-skeleton zak-skeleton-lg" style="width:70%;"></span>
        <span class="zak-skeleton zak-skeleton-sm"></span>
        <span class="zak-skeleton zak-skeleton-sm" style="width:80%;"></span>
    </div>
</div>

Skeleton List

Rows of avatars and lines approximate a loading list.

HTML
<div class="zak-stack">
    <div style="display:flex;gap:0.75rem;align-items:center;">
        <span class="zak-skeleton zak-skeleton-circle"></span>
        <div class="zak-stack" style="flex:1;">
            <span class="zak-skeleton zak-skeleton-sm"></span>
            <span class="zak-skeleton zak-skeleton-sm" style="width:50%;"></span>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

Skeleton Table

Rows of bars approximate a tabular layout.

HTML
<div class="zak-stack">
    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr;gap:1rem;">
        <span class="zak-skeleton zak-skeleton-sm"></span>
        <span class="zak-skeleton zak-skeleton-sm"></span>
        <span class="zak-skeleton zak-skeleton-sm"></span>
    </div>
</div>

Skeleton with Animation

The shimmer sweep runs automatically via ::after. Pause it with a custom class if needed.

HTML
/* Animation is built in via .zak-skeleton::after */
.zak-skeleton {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.zak-skeleton::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    transform: translateX(-100%);
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--zak-surface-hover), transparent);
    animation: zak-shimmer 1.5s infinite;
}
@keyframes zak-shimmer { 100% { transform: translateX(100%); } }

/* Opt out of reduced motion */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .zak-skeleton::after { animation: none; }
}

Skeleton with Custom Dimensions

Control width, height, and radius inline for bespoke shapes.

HTML
<!-- Circle -->
<span class="zak-skeleton" style="width:8rem;height:8rem;border-radius:50%;"></span>
<!-- Pill -->
<span class="zak-skeleton" style="width:4rem;height:1.5rem;border-radius:999px;"></span>
<!-- Bar -->
<span class="zak-skeleton" style="width:10rem;height:2rem;"></span>

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
.zak-skeleton           /* Base block/bar */
.zak-skeleton-circle     /* Circle shape (default 2.5rem) */
.zak-skeleton-sm         /* 0.5rem height */
.zak-skeleton-md         /* 0.75rem height */
.zak-skeleton-lg         /* 1.25rem height */
.zak-skeleton-xl         /* 2rem height */

/* Sizing helpers can be combined with inline width/height */

Accessibility

  • Mark the placeholder container with aria-busy="true" while data loads.
  • Add an aria-label such as "Loading" to the container for screen readers.
  • Do not leave skeletons visible for long periods; replace them as soon as content is available.
  • Respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling the shimmer animation.
HTML
<div class="zak-stack" aria-busy="true" aria-label="Loading content">
    <span class="zak-skeleton zak-skeleton-lg"></span>
    <span class="zak-skeleton"></span>
</div>
